propositions: Jira Data Center rate limiter (429 responses with Retry-After headers) is not honoured by rebar; a 429 propagates as a hard failure on first occurrence instead of being retried

_with_connection_retry is the single choke point for all 15 transport call sites including mutations like create_issue, so retrying 429s there would reintroduce the duplicate-issue bug because a 429 can arrive after the server began a write
429 retry must be scoped to idempotent reads only via per-call opt-in defaulting OFF; mutations must fail-fast to prevent duplicates
Jitter must be applied first then clamped to MAX_BACKOFF_S per Atlassian guidance: min(60.0, retry_after * (1 + random.uniform(0, 0.2)))
transport.py is at the locked 800-line cap with 11 lines headroom, forcing extraction of retry/error cluster to a separate module before 429 policy can be added
Retry-After must be read from exc.response.headers not exc.headers, and oversized values must be clamped not treated as hard failures
